uncertain: The elevations are 584 / 509 px wide (55 px per metre); frame edges were located on the pixel values and are good to about 2 px.

Ridge check: with the door bottom as zero the ridge computes to about 6.67-6.68 m on all four elevations against the printed +6,79 (6 px short). Either the rendered door stands a little above +-0,00 or the render differs slightly from the section; if the ridge is trusted instead, the zero row would be about 387.

Rear dormer: the section and attic plan put its window in the plane of the rear wall, but on the rear elevation a strip of roof with an unbroken eaves line runs below it; it is recorded as SHED. Its box takes in the visible dormer roof (y 67-171) and its face (x 249-371, y 171-207).
The page names the side elevations (lewa / prawa) and the plan agrees: no ground-floor opening on the left wall, the terrace door on the right wall. Neither is mirrored.
The porch gable on FRONT is an open roof on posts, not a dormer.
